newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco confirms seeking 40,000 tonnes of wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco confirms seeking 40,000 tonnes of wheat.

text.p: Morocco confirmed on Tuesday it plans to buy 40,000 tonnes of soft wheat for delivery in the first half of February.

An official at the Office National Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses said, "We will launch a tender on January 16, 1997 for the purchase of 40,000 tonnes optional soft wheat for delivery in the first half of February."
The quantity was a part of the 1.0 million tonnes of soft wheat which the agriculture ministry had scheduled for import in the 1996/1997 season, he added.
